cim: Buncombe students complete Mark Cuban Foundation's AI bootcamp at UNC Asheville
cim_eredeti: Buncombe students complete Mark Cuban Foundation's AI bootcamp at UNC Asheville
szoveg_eredeti:
ASHEVILLE, N.C. (WLOS) — Buncombe County students wrapped up two weeks of hands-on artificial intelligence training at UNC Asheville Saturday, Nov. 14, completing the Mark Cuban Foundation AI Bootcamp as one of only three camp locations in North Carolina.

Teachers and students spent the past two weeks learning alongside mentors experienced in the emerging technology.

WORKSHOP HELPS WESTERN NORTH CAROLINA LEADERS NAVIGATE AI USE

News 13 spoke with Buncombe County Schools Superintendent Dr. Jennifer Reed about the partnership with UNC Asheville and its role in helping students and educators navigate a topic that remains top of mind for many.

USING AI FOR HOME REPAIRS? EXPERT SAYS KNOW WHEN TO CALL A PROFESSIONAL

“Really, really proud to have this level of collaboration with UNCA... I’m really, really proud of it,” Reed said.

Students who completed the program will continue to receive mentorship and additional AI learning opportunities through graduation.
